title: openapi-index/1
description: The table of contents specs/index.json publishes for the OpenAPI documents under specs/: for each, its name (the filename stem, which carries the major: `wallet.v1`), its info.version, its path relative to the repository root, and the sha256 of its exact bytes. Mirrors buildIndex() in scripts/index-specs.mjs; test/openapi-index-schema.test.mjs fails if the two disagree about a key or a pattern. Written by hand, because the shape is small and the generator is the thing it is held to. Unknown keys are refused at both levels, with no `x-` extension: drift() refuses an unknown key in a row and test/specs-index.test.mjs refuses one at the top, and a schema that admitted what the repository's own checks reject would be promising something it does not hold.

contract.description: The contract identifier. CONTRACT in scripts/index-specs.mjs.

generated.description: When the index was last written. The one field that changes on every write, so comparisons against the files ignore it (drift() in scripts/index-specs.mjs). The generator writes an ISO 8601 UTC instant.

specs.description: One row per OpenAPI document under specs/, sorted by name. An index that lists none is refused: the generator throws rather than write one.

name.description: The filename stem, which carries the major version: `wallet.v1` for specs/wallet.v1.yaml. A breaking change mints `wallet.v2` and leaves this row alone.

version.description: The document's info.version, as three dot-separated integers. Its first number is the major in `name`.

path.description: The file, relative to the repository root and never absolute. Relative so that the same row works under whatever root a copy of the repository is served from.

sha256.description: Lower-case hex sha256 of the file's exact bytes, so a copy somewhere else can be checked against what this repository holds.
